_comment: Spawn DENSITY example - not loaded by ZombieMod, copy into your own datapack at
ZombieMod's genera claim spawns that vanilla was already going to make; they never add
spawns of their own. This is how you add them. It adds ordinary minecraft:zombie spawn
entries, and ZombieMod's weighted draw then decides which genus each one becomes - so
'more zombies in swamps' and 'swamp-flavoured zombies' compose rather than fighting.
Vanilla's own overworld zombie entry is weight 95, minCount 4, maxCount 4. Treat that as
your yardstick: the weight below is added alongside it, not instead of it.
